SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiXmlReader

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiXmlReader
public final class DexpiXmlReader extends Object
Utility for reading DEXPI XML files and converting them into NeqSim process models.

This reader recognises major equipment such as pumps, heat exchangers, tanks and control valves as well as complex reactors, compressors and inline analysers. Piping segments are imported as runnable DexpiStream units tagged with the source line number.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim
